title: System Engineer - AP
description:
**What is special about Lighthouse?**
Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.
  
  
**What’s unique about this role?**
This role is responsible for administrating, maintaining, monitoring, expanding, and troubleshooting 24x7 storage infrastructure in multiple datacenter locations. The systems engineer will work with other team members to ensure 100% availability for our hosting and SAAS infrastructure and support our Relativity, Nuix and eCapture systems in the US and EMEA.
  
  
**What will this person do?**

* Design and implement scalable, secure, and robust cloud solutions using Azure and Microsoft 365.
* Manage and optimize Azure resources, including VMs, Azure Active Directory, and Azure SQL databases.
* Configure and maintain Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Teams.
* Ensure cloud security by implementing proper access controls, network security groups, and firewalls.
* Automate cloud deployments and configuration management using Azure DevOps, PowerShell, and ARM templates.
* Monitor cloud performance, set up alerts, and respond to incidents to maintain high availability and business continuity.
* Collaborate with development teams to support CI/CD pipelines and promote DevOps best practices.
* Oversee the administration of guest accounts and manage external collaborations within the Microsoft 365 environment, ensuring secure access and compliance with company policies.
* Provide remediation guidance for Azure Identity and Access Management (IAM) to maintain compliance and address security vulnerabilities promptly.
* Design and manage a portfolio of multiple Azure subscriptions, establishing best practices for governance, ensuring security isolation, billing separation, and effective resource organization.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior cloud engineers.
* Stay current with the latest cloud technologies and trends and recommend improvements to our cloud strategy
* Experience with AD Connect, Azure federation, and hybrid synchronization
* Experience deploying and managing Intune mobile device management and Autopilot for Windows provisioning
* Experience in designing and deploying infrastructure and disaster recovery solutions on Azure
* Experience with Microsoft AD, DNS, DHCP, DFS, and GPO Management
* Experience with Azure infrastructure services build and operations such as, Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts (Blob)
* SSO application integration via SAML, OAuth, OIDC
* Experience with management of device identities, conditional access policies
* Strong understanding of cloud security principles and compliance standards
* Experience with automation and scripting using PowerShell, Azure CLI, PowerAutomate, Python, or similar technologies
* Proficiency with Azure DevOps Pipeline capabilities, leveraging CI/CD for efficient deployment of data systems and applications
* Advanced source control skills with Git, including the use of GitHub features such as actions, and managing merged/pull requests. Experience in maintaining repositories for storing scripts, notebooks, and other code artifacts
* Demonstrated ability using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) on the Azure platform to provision and manage cloud resources such as managed services, servers, databases, etc., with a focus on automation and scalability
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes is a plus
* Experience deploying and managing MS Copilot a plus
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to interact with diverse stakeholders.
* Automation, configuration, or orchestration products like SCCM, Intune, and Ansible
* 3+ years experience with automation, configuration, or orchestration products like SCCM, Intune, and Ansible
* experience as a Windows server, Linux, VMWare, or Storage Administrator

**Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you have the following:**

* Strong analytical skill with a demonstrated ability to understand and document business data requirements in complete, accurate, extensible, flexible logical data models
* Ability to plan, scope and estimate work effort to produce high quality deliverables on time/on budget
* Proven ability to troubleshoot storage environments using vendor utilities and 3rd party tools
* Participate in on-call rotation supporting systems after-hours, weekends and holidays
* Strong understanding of data center design and principles - hosting experience a plus
* Typically requires a High School degree or equivalent experience.
* Typically requires 3 to 5 yrs. of experience in building scalable, fault-tolerant storage infrastructures to support cloud computing & remote hosting.

**Work Environment and Physical Demands**
Duties are performed in a typical office environment while at a desk or computer table. Duties require the ability to use a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material, in a quiet and professional setting.
  
  
Duties may require occasionally working outside normal business hours (evenings and weekends).
  
  
Lighthouse celebrates and thrives on diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire, train, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We welcome any talents and contributions you can bring to the team and are deeply committed to growing an environment where everyone can feel safe, is respected, and can show up as themselves. Come as you are!
  
  
As required by applicable pay transparency laws, Lighthouse complies with compensation disclosure requirements for roles that may be hired in locations under these requirements. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include a wide array of factors, including: your specific skills and experience, geographic location, or other relevant factors. The salary range for this position may be tailored to be lower or higher in different talent markets.
  
  
The expected pay for this role will range from $86,625 to $115,500 per year. This role will be eligible to participate in an annual bonus or incentive program.
  
  
Lighthouse offers a quality comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and a 401k with company match. Company paid benefits also include Life & AD&D, short and long-term disability, telemedicine through 98point6, and other wellness plans. We offer a generous Flexible PTO program and paid volunteer days. Employees may also participate in voluntary insurance plans including accident, hospitalization, and critical illness plans as well as pet insurance.
  
  
As a trailblazer and catalyst for change, Lighthouse rises to each opportunity to help our clients and our people do what they do best—shine.
  
  
**What is special about Lighthouse?**
Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.
  
  
**What’s unique about this role?**
The system engineer role is responsible for complete management of the hardware, operating system, and non-application services of lighthouse Global Datacenter Services infrastructure. This role supports maximizing server availability, hardware and operating system configuration, performance reporting and tuning, capacity management, problem resolution, and testing. This includes solution formulation, implementation, documentation, and follow-up. The system engineer role requires attention to detail and 24×7 support availability by participating in an on-call rotation schedule.
  
  
**What will this person do?**

* Manage and maintain global data center system’s hardware and operating system configurations.
* Perform patching and vulnerability remediation to meet compliance standards.
* Manage and maintain core system applications: messaging, virtualization, business continuity, and data protection.
* Provide problem resolution and act as a subject matter expert to the business. (Daily, 24×7)
* Provide team feedback and drive improvements with current tools and processes.
* Review shift reports to ensure all break/fix issues are resolved in a timely manner or properly escalated to the appropriate group.
* Communicate proper expectations for scope and deadlines to internal and external stakeholders.
* Perform hands-on analysis of the production systems, fault resolution, capacity planning and root cause analysis for critical issues.
* Analyze and resolve performance issues, capacity issues, replication, and other distributed data.
* Maintain operation, configuration, or other procedures and documentation.
* Participate in on-call rotation supporting systems after-hours, weekends, and holidays.
* Manage and escalate cases to vendors for problem resolution.
* Perform periodic performance reporting to support capacity planning.
* Automate processes to operate production systems.
* Act and work both independently and in a team environment.

**Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you have the following:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or equivalent.
* 3 – 5 years of Systems Administration experience preferred in the following areas:
* Managing virtual server systems in an enterprise environment
* Developing and Managing automation tools in an enterprise environment
* Compute technologies.
* Storage technologies.
* Experience with MS SCCM or other monitoring style packages.
* MSCE or other industry certifications
* Experience in managing & supporting scalable, fault-tolerant infrastructures in a hybrid (Azure Cloud + Data Center) environment.
* Proficient in MS PowerShell or similar scripting language
* Extensive background in hardware maintenance and datacenter operations.
* Proven capability to manage day to day activity in a ticketing system.
* Working knowledge of security principles related to infrastructure management.
* Experience with ITIL or other process frameworks.
* Ability to quickly understand new tool/process improvement and drive the implementation to further enhance service excellence.
* Implementation and management of Microsoft Windows/VMware/Hyper-V environments.
* Management of Azure components such as active directory, Office 365 etc.
* Implementation and migration of hypervisors (strong Hyper-V skills a plus)
* Good understanding of VMware & Azure platforms.
* Ability to handle multiple jobs at the same time.
* Ability to always pay attention to details.
* Ability to take proactive steps in managing problems.
* Must be very security conscious to avoid sensitive data falling into wrong hands.
* Ability to effectively handle stress, pressures, and challenges.
* Solid understanding of data center design and principles - hosting experience a plus.
* Ability to plan, scope and estimate work effort to produce high quality deliverables on time/on budget.
* Good understanding of Microsoft active directory principles.
* Ability to work with diverse teams (national and international) in a collaborative manner.
* Intellectual curiosity and the ability to learn new concepts quickly and efficiently.
* Highly solution focused; strong sense of urgency with a passion for 100% availability.

**Work Environment and Physical Demands**

* Duties are performed in a typical office environment while at a desk or computer table.
* Duties require the ability to use a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material, in a quiet and professional setting.
* Duties may require being on call periodically and working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends).

Lighthouse celebrates and thrives on diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire, train, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We welcome any talents and contributions you can bring to the team and are deeply committed to growing an environment where everyone can feel safe, is respected, and can show up as themselves. Come as you are!
  
  
As a trailblazer and catalyst for change, Lighthouse rises to each opportunity to help our clients and our people do what they do best—shine.
  
  
This position will work for and be employed by Lighthouse's India subsidiary, which is an independent company located in India.

title: NetScaler Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**
The NetScaler Engineer owns the design, operation, and security of the Citrix NetScaler (formerly Citrix ADC) environment, with a primary focus on the NetScaler Gateway (Citrix Access Gateway) platform that gives employees and partners secure remote access to Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops.
  
  
The role keeps remote access available, fast, and secure; resolves complex connectivity and authentication issues; and leads upgrades, patching, and improvements across the gateway estate.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Citrix Access Gateway Support (Primary Focus)**

* Administer, configure, and maintain NetScaler Gateway virtual servers for ICA proxy access to Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops and Citrix Workspace
* Integrate gateways with StoreFront and/or Citrix Cloud (Workspace), including session policies, profiles, callback URLs, and Secure Ticket Authority (STA) configuration
* Build and support authentication flows using nFactor, LDAP/LDAPS, RADIUS, SAML, and multi-factor authentication providers such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Duo, or RSA
* Configure and troubleshoot Endpoint Analysis (EPA) scans, SmartAccess and SmartControl policies, and client certificate authentication
* Serve as the escalation point for remote access incidents, including login failures, STA errors, session drops, HDX/EDT performance, and reconnect problems
* Support HDX optimization through the gateway, including EDT (UDP/DTLS), Session Reliability, and audio/video for Microsoft Teams and softphone traffic

**NetScaler Platform Operations**

* Manage NetScaler BLX, CPX, VPX, MPX, and/or SDX appliances in high-availability pairs and clusters, including GSLB across data centers
* Plan and execute firmware upgrades and emergency security patching, tracking vendor security bulletins and CVEs and applying fixes within defined SLAs
* Manage SSL/TLS certificates, cipher groups, and SSL profiles; track renewals to prevent certificate-related gateway outages
* Configure load balancing, content switching, responder, and rewrite policies for StoreFront, Director, and other internal services
* Use NetScaler Console (formerly ADM), logs, and packet traces such as nstrace and Wireshark for monitoring, analytics, and root-cause analysis
* Automate configuration and routine tasks with the NITRO API, PowerShell, Python, or Ansible/Terraform where practical
* Migrate NetScalers from VMware ESXi clusters to Oracle OCI clusters

**Security, Change Management & Documentation**

* Harden gateway configurations against current security baselines and support vulnerability scans, penetration tests, and audits
* Follow change-management processes for all production changes, including test plans, rollback steps, and post-change validation
* Maintain current architecture diagrams, runbooks, configuration standards, and disaster recovery procedures
* Work with Citrix/VDI, Active Directory, identity, firewall, network, and service desk teams, and with vendor support on escalated cases

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of Hands-on experience deploying and troubleshooting NetScaler Gateway for Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (XenApp/XenDesktop) and StoreFront
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, SSL/TLS, PKI, HTTP, and load-balancing concepts
* Experience with directory and identity integration, including Active Directory, LDAP, RADIUS, SAML, and MFA providers
* Proficiency with packet-capture analysis and structured troubleshooting of authentication and connectivity issues
* Experience with high-availability pair operations, firmware upgrades, and certificate lifecycle management
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical users
* Ability to overlap 5 hours with US Central time zone hours

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Current NetScaler or Citrix networking certification, such as Citrix Certified Associate or Professional - Networking
* Understanding of virtualization platforms such as VMware ESXi and Oracle OCI
* Experience with Citrix Cloud, Gateway Service, Cloud Connectors, and hybrid Citrix deployments
* Experience with NetScaler Console (ADM), GSLB, and Web App Firewall (WAF)
* Scripting and automation experience with the NITRO API, PowerShell, Python, Ansible, or Terraform
* Exposure to Zero Trust or ZTNA alternatives, such as Citrix Secure Private Access, and cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS
* Experience in a regulated environment, such as healthcare (HIPAA) or finance

title: Cloud Migration Lead Engineer
description:
**Req ID:**
395339
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Cloud Migration Lead Engineer to join our team in TG, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
  
  
Cloud Migration Engineer – AWS / Azure
  
  
**Experience:**
6+ years in IT infrastructure, including 2+ years of hands-on cloud migration or cloud infrastructure experience.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are looking for hands-on Cloud Migration Engineers to execute enterprise workload migrations, primarily to AWS, with Microsoft Azure experience considered an advantage.
  
  
This is an execution-focused engineering position. The successful candidate must have practical experience migrating production servers or applications from on-premises or virtualized environments to public cloud platforms.
  
  
We are particularly interested in engineers with strong Windows/Linux infrastructure backgrounds who have participated directly in migration projects.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Execute server and workload migrations from on-premises, VMware, and other cloud environments to AWS.
* Configure and operate AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) and other migration tools.
* Perform source server assessments, agent installation, replication configuration, and migration readiness checks.
* Execute test migrations, validate replicated workloads, and troubleshoot migration issues.
* Participate in migration wave planning and technical cutover preparation.
* Perform production cutovers, post-migration validation, and hypercare activities.
* Troubleshoot operating system, networking, storage, DNS, Active Directory, and application connectivity issues.
* Support migration runbook creation, technical documentation, and rollback procedures.
* Collaborate with Technical Leads, Cloud Foundation Engineers, and customer application owners.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive migration activities and improve migration efficiency.

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

* Hands-on experience migrating Windows and/or Linux servers to AWS or another public cloud.
* Practical experience with AWS EC2, EBS, VPC, security groups, and basic IAM.
* Experience with AWS MGN, Azure Migrate, VMware HCX, RiverMeadow, or comparable server migration technologies.
* Strong Windows Server and/or Linux administration and troubleshooting experience.
* Knowledge of VMware vSphere or similar virtualization technologies.
* Understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, routing, firewalls, and basic network troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with server replication, testing, cutover, rollback, and post-migration validation.
* Experience troubleshooting infrastructure and operating system issues.
* Ability to follow migration runbooks and execute production changes safely.

Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  

* Microsoft Azure VM migration experience and Azure Migrate.
* AWS Transform, RiverMeadow, CloudHedge, or other migration accelerators.
* PowerShell, Bash, Python, or automation scripting.
* Terraform, Ansible, or basic Infrastructure as Code experience.
* Active Directory, Group Policy, and Windows infrastructure services.
* SQL Server, Oracle, or other database migration exposure.
* AWS networking, VPN, Direct Connect, or hybrid connectivity.
* AWS IAM, cloud security, or operational monitoring.
* Experience with application dependency mapping and migration discovery.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps Administrator, or equivalent certification.

Expected Outcomes
  
  

* Independently execute assigned migration tasks and migration waves.
* Deliver successful server migrations with minimal rework.
* Identify and resolve replication, cutover, and post-migration issues.
* Contribute to reusable migration procedures and automation.
* Support predictable, repeatable, high-volume migration delivery.

**Critical selection criterion:**
Candidates must demonstrate direct involvement in real server or workload migrations. General cloud operations, monitoring, or infrastructure support experience alone is insufficient.
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.

title: AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect
description:
**Location \& work modality: India ( Remote)
   

  

**About Submer**
 Submer enables organizations scaling AI to overcome the limits of traditional datacenters across power, compute density and efficiency.
   

  

 We design and deliver scalable, high\-density AI datacenter infrastructure built around industry\-leading liquid cooling, supporting everything from early AI deployments to full\-scale production environments.**
**What Impact You Will Have**
**We are looking for AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect**
**Department:** 
 Solutions Engineering / Presales
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect is responsible for designing end\-to\-end AI infrastructure solutions that enable customers to deploy scalable, high\-performance AI and HPC environments. The role combines technical presales, solution architecture, infrastructure sizing, and deployment planning to deliver commercially viable and operationally sound AI infrastructure solutions.
   

  

 The architect serves as the technical authority for compute, networking, storage, AI software stack, and infrastructure integration while working closely with Sales, Delivery, Product Management, OEM partners, and the Facilities Presales \& Design teams to ensure that the AI infrastructure requirements are fully aligned with the data center's power, cooling, space, and physical infrastructure capabilities.
   

  

 This role owns the AI infrastructure architecture and complements the facility design process.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**What you will do**
* AI Infrastructure Presales
* Partner with Sales to qualify AI infrastructure opportunities.
* Engage with customers to understand AI workloads, performance expectations, scalability requirements, and operational objectives.
* Conduct technical discovery workshops and architecture discussions.
* Prepare technical proposals, presentations, and solution demonstrations.
* Support RFI, RFP, and RFQ responses.
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor throughout the sales lifecycle.
* AI Infrastructure Solution Architecture


**Design Complete AI Infrastructure Solutions Including**
* GPU compute clusters
* AI Factory infrastructure
* HPC platforms
* High\-performance storage
* AI networking fabrics (Ethernet, InfiniBand, RoCE)
* Kubernetes and container platforms
* AI software stack integration
* Cluster management
* Security architecture
* Monitoring and observability
* Automation platforms
* Scalability and expansion planning


**Develop**
* Solution architecture
* Infrastructure sizing
* Bill of Materials (BoM)
* Reference architectures
* Technical specifications
* Solution documentation
* Deployment architecture
* Infrastructure Integration with Data Center Design


 Work closely with Facilities Presales, Design, and Engineering teams to ensure the AI infrastructure solution is fully compatible with the proposed data center environment.
   

  

**Provide Technical Inputs Related To**
* Rack power density
* Rack layouts
* GPU server deployment
* Network topology
* Cable density
* Space requirements
* Liquid cooling interfaces
* CDU connectivity requirements
* Infrastructure dependencies
* Expansion strategy


 Validate that the AI infrastructure can be successfully deployed within the facility constraints without owning the facility design itself.
   

  

* Solution Validation \& Delivery Readiness


 Collaborate with Delivery and Engineering teams to ensure solution feasibility.
   

  

**Support**
* Technical design reviews
* OEM interoperability validation
* Deployment planning
* Installation readiness
* Factory acceptance planning
* Site acceptance planning
* Commissioning support
* Technical handover to delivery teams


 Maintain ownership of the AI infrastructure solution throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

* Operational Architecture


 Ensure the proposed solution is designed for long\-term operational success by considering:
   

  

* Serviceability

description:

We are advancing how computing solves the world’s most sophisticated challenges in science, industry, and enterprise. You will own the full project lifecycle from strategic alignment and solution design through deployment, stabilization, and production handover.

* Lead regular syncs, governance calls, and status updates with global internal teams, customers, and third\-party partners.
* Own delivery of complex on\-site or remote data center installations, escalate issues appropriately, and drive resolution with cross\-functional partners.

title: Engineer II - Field Service
description:
**Job Description**
**Brief Job Description:**
**Brief Job Description**
 Responsible for providing on\-site and remote technical support, maintenance, and troubleshooting for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, PDU (Power Distribution Units), STS (Static transfer Switches), AHF (Active Harmonic filters) and other similar Power electronics products. The role requires extensive knowledge of UPS systems, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work independently or as part of a team to ensure the reliability and performance of power systems.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Technical Support:


 Provide on\-site and remote support for installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of UPS systems.
   

  

 Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network\-related issues affecting UPS performance.
   

  

 Assist in the configuration and commissioning of new UPS installations.
   

  

* Preventive Maintenance:


 Conduct routine inspections and preventive maintenance on UPS systems to ensure optimal performance.
   

  

 Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, including any repairs or replacements.
   

  

* Customer Interaction:


 Communicate effectively with customers to understand their needs and provide appropriate solutions.
   

  

 Train customers on the proper use and maintenance of UPS systems.
   

  

* Documentation and Reporting:


 Prepare detailed reports of service visits, including diagnostic findings, actions taken, and recommendations for future maintenance.
   

  

 Maintain up\-to\-date documentation of all service activities and customer interactions.
   

  

* Technical Training and Development:


 Stay current with the latest developments in UPS technology and industry best practices.
   

  

 Participate in ongoing training and professional development to enhance technical skills and knowledge.
   

  

* Compliance and Safety:


 Adhere to all safety protocols and guidelines to ensure a safe working environment.
   

  

 Ensure compliance with company policies and industry standards in all service activities.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Education: Diploma/bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering/Electronics Engineering.
* Experience: Minimum of 8years of experience in UPS systems support or a related field.


 Experience with Vertiv Products is preferable.
   

  

* Technical Skills:


 Strong understanding of electrical and electronics principles and UPS technology.
   

  

 Proficiency in diagnosing and repairing UPS systems.
   

  

 Familiarity with network protocols and remote monitoring tools.
   

  

* Soft Skills:


 Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
   

  

 Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
   

  

 Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively.
   

  

**Work Environment**
 The position may require travel to customer sites and may involve working in various environmental conditions.
   

  

 Flexibility to work outside regular business hours for emergency support and maintenance activities.

 Ability to travel as needed.

 Same Posting Description for Internal and External Candidates
